subject: Startups
subcategory: The Art of the Startup Pitch
title: Data as Drama
description: A quick, practical guide to Data as Drama.

hook.text: 'We grew 300% last quarter' is data. 'We went from 10 users to 10,000 in 90 days' is drama. Same fact, different power.

buildup.text: Raw numbers are forgettable. Numbers embedded in narrative become proof points that investors carry home.

discovery.text: Stripe's pitch showed payment API calls growing week over week. The curve told the story better than any words.

twist.text: Too many charts kill a pitch. Pick the 2–3 numbers that prove the thesis and let them shine. Less is dramatic.

climax.text: Data earns credibility. Story earns attention. The best pitches weave both into a single thread.

punchline.text: Make the data tell a story. Numbers alone don't move people.

quiz.question: Why is framing data as a narrative more effective?
options: Numbers in stories are more memorable and persuasive
